purpose: Capture the useful evidence-packet shape from a structured Deep Research run so Brand3 can compare it against local Evidence Packet v0.
useful_behaviors: separates audited surface from related surfaces
uses explicit links to justify related repository/developer surfaces
does not treat same-name entities as aliases
preserves marketplace and directory evidence as bounded evidence
keeps unsupported usage claims out of finding eligibility
tracks contradictions as candidates rather than conclusions
cautions: primary entity confidence may still be too high when based mostly on owned links
marketplace listings should not automatically be finding-eligible
blog or directory commentary should not prove differentiation superiority
repository activity should not imply adoption
recommended_role: benchmark for local Evidence Packet v0
prompt-contract reference for future Deep Research tests
design target for Exa/Web acquisition ordering
recommended_next_step: Compare the reference contract field-by-field against local Evidence Packet v0 and decide what Brand3 can build cheaply from existing Exa/Web data.
